symbols.name: canceled_and_refunded
symbols.description: state: the order was canceled and its payments refunded

symbols.name: order_fulfilled
symbols.description: response: the system fulfills the order

symbols.name: order_backordered
symbols.description: response: the system places the order on backorder

symbols.name: payments_refunded
symbols.description: response: the system refunds all payments of the order

rules.text: WHEN an order is submitted AND inventory is available, THE Order System SHALL fulfill the order.
WHEN an order is submitted AND inventory is unavailable, THE Order System SHALL place the order on backorder.
THE Order System SHALL NOT place any order on backorder.
WHEN an order is canceled, THE Order System SHALL refund all associated payments.
WHILE an order is in a canceled-and-refunded state, THE Order System SHALL NOT fulfill the order.
